objective: Deterministic Frontend Composition Orchestration across the 9-Axis SSOT (Logical Box Model, Fluid Typography, 3-Layer OKLCH Tokens, 3-Level Shadows, @container, 4 Card Variants, 3-Layer Navigation, 3 Complexity Levels) in 3 Waves (3+1 Topology)
acceptance_criteria: Wave 1 (ui-shell-navigator): Diagnose purpose and Complexity Level (1/2/3), apply Logical Box Model + flow-root/gap, define 3-layer OKLCH tokens (--bg-canvas/--surface-canvas, light-dark()), select 1 of 6 Archetypes + @container, and structure 3-Layer Semantic Navigation (Global, Local, Breadcrumbs <ol role='list'> + aria-current='page')

Wave 2A (ui-controls-data): Implement 4 Card Variants (Elevated, Outlined, Filled, Interactive), zenith lighting (90-120 deg), 3 shadow types/levels (--shadow-elevation-1..3 + isolation: isolate), fluid typography (clamp, 65ch, balance/pretty, antialiased, font-synthesis: none, tabular-nums), and Real-State Engineering (executable FSM)

Wave 2B (ui-motion-interaction): Calibrate physical transitions (cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) and cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)), integer tactile feedback without fractional scale(), pointer: coarse >= 44px, PWA standalone, :focus-visible, and prefers-reduced-motion
Wave 3 (ui-deterministic-observer): Mathematically audit the 9-Axis SSOT via scripts/audit_tactile_ui.py, ui_ux_frontend_auditor.py, and deterministic_scorer.py (Readiness Score >= 90/100)
